text.p: Federal Reserve Board Governor Susan Phillips said Friday that Fed Chairman Alan Greenspan would deliver his Humphrey-Hawkins testimony on the economy Feb. 26 and Feb. 27.
Phillips, asked about the state of the U.S. economy, deferred to Greenspan's upcoming semi-annual testimony on monetary policy and the economy.
The House Banking Committee had already confirmed Greenspan's Feb. 27 appearance but the Senate Banking Committee had declined to confirm Feb. 26.
Asked about Phillips' comments, a spokesman for the Senate Banking Committee in Washington said a date had still not been confirmed.
